hero.title: SRU Alumni — Leaders Changing the World
hero.description: Your studies are complete and your impact journey begins — the SRU alumni network spans more than 40 countries, and every graduate is an ambassador of the excellence and values you were equipped with at your university.

network.title: More Than 15,000 Graduates Worldwide
network.description: SRU graduates leave their mark in medicine, engineering, business, education, and technology across Saudi Arabia and beyond. Join this powerful network and be part of a community that makes a difference.

cta_banner.title: Your relationship with SRU doesn't end — it begins again
cta_banner.description: Join the alumni network, access the latest career opportunities, and stay connected with your university and peers.

career_services.title: We Support Your Professional Journey
career_services.description: SRU's Career Services Centre continues to support you after graduation through an extensive partner network and specialised development programmes.

services.title: Direct Job Placement
services.description: SRU graduates' exclusive jobs portal provides direct vacancies from top companies and government bodies across the Kingdom.

services.title: Personal Career Coaching
services.description: Book one-on-one coaching sessions with career development specialists to review your CV, prepare for interviews, and design your career path.

services.title: Annual Career Fair
services.description: The annual fair brings together 80+ employers in a single day with opportunities for on-the-spot interviews, professional networking, and development workshops.

continuing_education.title: Never Stop Growing — Exclusive Learning for SRU Alumni
continuing_education.description: As an SRU graduate, you receive preferential access to continuing education programmes, postgraduate studies, and professional certifications at discounted rates.

programmes.title: Masters & PhD for SRU Graduates
programmes.description: Apply easily to SRU postgraduate programmes with admission priority and a 20% tuition discount for university graduates.

programmes.title: Accredited Professional Development
programmes.description: Earn recognised professional certificates in management, data analytics, digital marketing, and project management.

programmes.title: Intensive Workshops & Bootcamps
programmes.description: Intensive sessions ranging from two days to two weeks in AI skills, entrepreneurship, leadership, and public speaking.

benefits.title: Your SRU Badge — Lifelong Privileges
benefits.description: Graduating from SRU isn't the end of your relationship with the university — it's the start of a series of exclusive privileges designed to support you for life.

items.title: Lifetime Digital Library Access
items.description: Retain full access to over 500,000 resources in the university's digital library for life as an alumnus.

items.title: 20% Postgraduate Tuition Discount
items.description: Apply to any Masters or PhD programme at SRU and enjoy a 20% tuition discount exclusively for alumni.

items.title: Exclusive Professional Network
items.description: Connect with 15,000+ alumni through SRU's exclusive professional networking platform and benefit from partnership and collaboration opportunities.

items.title: Free Lifelong Career Coaching
items.description: Book free career coaching sessions with our specialists at any point in your journey, even years after graduation.

items.title: Priority Access to University Events
items.description: Receive early invitations and booking priority for all university events, conferences, and graduation ceremonies.

items.title: Campus Facilities Access
items.description: Enjoy access to university facilities — library, labs, and sports courts — after graduation at discounted rates for network members.

items.title: Exclusive Alumni Newsletter
items.description: Receive a monthly dedicated newsletter with the latest university news, job opportunities, and highlights from top alumni worldwide.

items.title: Annual Alumni Excellence Awards
items.description: An annual award honouring distinguished SRU graduates in professional excellence, entrepreneurship, and community responsibility.

success_stories.title: Our Graduates — Inspiration Beyond Campus Walls
success_stories.description: Real stories from graduates who changed their trajectories and impacted their communities — each story carries a spark of excellence that began at SRU.

stories.name: Noura Al-Mutairi
stories.quote: The education I received at SRU qualified me to work at Aramco and participate in giant energy projects serving millions of people.

stories.name: Mohammed Al-Omari
stories.quote: The SRU alumni network opened doors I never expected — through it I joined the Saudi Youth Council and built truly impactful projects.

left.title: Alumni Portal — Stay Connected with Your University
left.description: Log in to the alumni portal to access all your privileges — job opportunities, development programmes, the alumni network, and all services available to SRU graduates.
features: Connect with the global alumni network
Share your success story with the SRU community

right.form_subtitle: Use your university email or previous student ID to sign in.

cta.title: Your Journey Started at SRU — Continue It With Us
cta.description: Join the alumni network and unlock all your privileges, or start your university journey with us today if you haven't yet enrolled.
